claim: Mindbody's developer FAQ says there is a 1,000-call daily limit on the API and that each call beyond it is charged at one third of a cent, that you are charged only for use with live clients, and that sandbox testing is free but restricted to 1,000 calls a day.
quote: There is a 1,000 call limit per day when using the API. Once this limit is reached, you will be charged one third of a cent for every call. You will be charged to use the API only with live clients. Testing through the sandbox is free of charge, but is restricted to 1,000 calls a day.

Mindbody calculates and bills its fees and charges on a monthly basis.

claim: ... starting 30 days after you first receive access to Subscriber data ...
